statement: For every real a,b >= 0 with a+b > 0, SDP_GL(G_{a,b}) = psi(G_{a,b}) = 5*min(a+2*b,2*a+b)/(6*(a+b)). Regarding cuts as unordered bipartitions and working up to the dihedral action, the optimal cuts are exactly the adjacent-pair orbit when a>b (including b=0), exactly the difference-two-pair orbit when b>a (including a=0), and every nontrivial cut when a=b>0. Modulo positive scaling, the nonzero optimal translation-invariant GL-feasible semimetrics are exactly v=2u when a>b, exactly u=2v when b>a, and every u,v>0 satisfying u<=2v and v<=2u when a=b>0. Translation averaging preserves squared-Euclidean realizability, all triangle inequalities, N, and D, so no non-translation-invariant feasible semimetric has a smaller objective.
contribution: A complete exact proof of the frozen two-weight Z/5Z claim: direct-sum translation symmetrization, a derived Fourier/CND description and exact invariant GL cone, exhaustive cut orbits, one-variable cone optimization, and every strict, face, and tie equality case. The accompanying primary-source screen distinguishes the interior result from the source's cycle-face and image-size-at-most-four theorems without asserting priority.
